description: This file contains utility functions for fetching and parsing version information from GitHub releases and Maven repositories, including regex patterns, filtering, sorting, and network request handling.

methods.name: isStable
methods.description: Determines if a version string represents a stable release by checking for 'alpha', 'beta', or '-rc' in the version string.

methods.name: filterToDistinct
methods.description: Filters an array to include only distinct values, removing duplicates.

methods.name: sortVersions
methods.description: Sorts version strings in descending order, considering numeric parts for proper version comparison.

methods.name: getLatestGitHubRelease
methods.description: Fetches the latest stable release tag from a GitHub repository using the GitHub API.

methods.name: getLatestMavenVersion
methods.description: Fetches the latest stable version from a Maven repository's metadata XML.

calls: replacements for regex and array methods
